en_title: GTA 6 Reveals a Handful of Radio Stations, DJs, and Songs Ahead of Release
subtitle: 步行也能听电台
opus_summary: Rockstar上线新网站，供玩家试听《GTA6》部分电台与歌曲，多位明星参与主持。游戏还支持通过手机和耳机在步行时收听电台与点播播客，将于11月19日发售。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has launched a new website which allows you to listen to some of the radio stations and songs that will be featured in GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar上线了一个新网站，玩家可以在网站上试听《GTA6》中的部分电台与歌曲。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar said GTA 6 will feature the "biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet," and, as always, has hired a number of celebrities such as Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey to host the stations. As for some of the things you'll be able to listen to, here are all of the stations and some of the songs that Rockstar has revealed so far.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar表示，《GTA6》的游戏内电台将提供「迄今数量最多、涵盖范围最广的内容」，并一如既往地邀请Morgan Wallen、Lana Del Rey等多位明星担任电台主持。至于玩家能听到哪些内容，以下是Rockstar目前公布的全部电台及部分歌曲。

paragraphs.en: Cocoteo FM: Leonida's home for the best of modern Latin music. Hosted by El Martillo (voiced by Bad Bunny) and La Gata (voiced by RaiNao) and featuring everything from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton – Cocoteo FM is el party que nunca se apaga .
paragraphs.cn: Cocoteo FM：在Leonida收听顶尖现代拉丁音乐的去处。电台由El Martillo（Bad Bunny配音）和La Gata（RaiNao配音）主持，从巴恰塔（bachata）、梅伦格（merengue）到登波（dembow）和雷鬼顿（reggaeton），各种曲风应有尽有——Cocoteo FM是一场永不落幕的派对。

paragraphs.en: Back Country Radio: MW (voiced by Morgan Wallen) and Delta Dawne (voiced by Lana Del Rey) blast renegade country music to the Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, and beyond. Stay tuned for Back Country’s roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and Delta’s not-so-secret lover Mud Dog Mike (voiced by Jeremy Dufrene) checking in from the driver’s seat of his Grassrivers airboat.
paragraphs.cn: Back Country Radio：MW（Morgan Wallen配音）和Delta Dawne（Lana Del Rey配音）将叛逆的乡村音乐响彻Grassrivers、Port Gellhorn及更远的地方。敬请收听Mud Dog Mike（Jeremy Dufrene配音）从他在Grassrivers的风扇船驾驶座上传来的连线报道。他既是Back Country的流动记者、沼泽气象员，也是Delta那位不算秘密的情人。

paragraphs.en: AfroBank FM: Turn up the gbedu with Burna (voiced by Burna Boy) and Palmsy (voiced by Palms Trax), AfroBank FM's dynamic duo curating the best in African music, from 20th-century classics and undiscovered gems to contemporary sounds like amapiano, 3-step, and more.
paragraphs.cn: AfroBank FM：跟随Burna（Burna Boy配音）和Palmsy（Palms Trax配音），把音乐（gbedu）的音量调大。这对活力十足的AfroBank FM搭档精选非洲音乐佳作，从20世纪的经典与鲜为人知的遗珠，到amapiano、3-step等当代曲风，无所不包。

paragraphs.en: The Chamber 106.6: Crushing metal has landed in Leonida. Jump in the pit with DJ Kerry (voiced by Kerry King) and DJ Tom (voiced by Tom Araya) for classic metal from the ‘80s and beyond as they channel Leonida’s deep metal roots.
paragraphs.cn: The Chamber 106.6：震撼的金属乐已登陆Leonida。跟随DJ Kerry（Kerry King配音）和DJ Tom（Tom Araya配音）冲进冲撞区，聆听80年代及之后的经典金属乐，感受他们呈现的Leonida深厚的金属乐底蕴。

paragraphs.en: Flash FM: The Vice City institution that delivers the best in pop music with Robyn (voiced by herself) and Alex (voiced by Alex Consani) — guaranteed to make you dance no matter where you find yourself in the Goodtime State.
paragraphs.cn: Flash FM：这家罪恶都市的老牌电台由Robyn（本人配音）和Alex（Alex Consani配音）带来顶尖流行音乐——无论你身处这个欢乐之州的哪个角落，都保证让你跳起舞来。

paragraphs.en: Dirty South Classics: A little southern hospitality from Trick (voiced by Trick Daddy) and Trina (voiced by herself), blasting regional rap and hip-hop classics. From the beach to the block, nobody reps Leonida and the South like they do.
paragraphs.cn: Dirty South Classics：Trick（Trick Daddy配音）和Trina（本人配音）以响亮的本地说唱与嘻哈经典，送上一份南方人的热情。从海滩到街区，没有人能像他们一样代表Leonida和南方。

paragraphs.en: This small selection does confirm there will be a wide variety of music, as some of the music featured includes the likes of Charli XCX, Bad Bunny, MGMT, DJ Khaled, and Black Sabbath. It's unclear if Rockstar will reveal the entire list of tracks in GTA 6 before launch, but this does provide a pretty good idea of what we'll be getting on November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然目前只公布了一小部分内容，但已足以确认游戏中的音乐风格相当多样，其中包括Charli XCX、Bad Bunny、MGMT、DJ Khaled和Black Sabbath等音乐人的作品。目前尚不清楚Rockstar是否会在发售前公布《GTA6》的完整曲目列表，不过，这些内容已经让我们对11月19日能听到什么有了相当清晰的了解。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, Rockstar released a small batch of new screenshots and confirmed that GTA 6 will feature the ability to listen to on-demand podcasts and radio stations on foot by using a pair of headphones and your smartphone. This is a massive feature that fans have wanted for years, as the radio has previously been confined to your vehicles and inside of select buildings. However, now players will be able to listen to music freely when they're in combat, exploring on foot, and more.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，Rockstar还公布了一小批新截图，并确认《GTA6》支持玩家通过耳机和智能手机，在步行时收听点播播客与电台。这是粉丝多年来一直盼望的重要功能，因为此前玩家只能在载具和部分建筑内收听电台。如今，玩家在战斗、徒步探索等情况下也能自由听音乐。

paragraphs.en: In September, Rockstar Games confirmed that it will release an album comprised of original music, made for GTA 6. So far, Rockstar has confirmed original songs from Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Keith Richards, and more. The entire tracklist has yet to be revealed, but it wouldn't be surprising if we hear more about the album later this month or early November ahead of the game's launch.
paragraphs.cn: 9月，Rockstar确认将发行一张专辑，收录专为《GTA6》创作的原创音乐。目前，Rockstar已确认其中包含Travis Scott、Morgan Wallen、Keith Richards等人的原创歌曲。完整曲目列表尚未公布，不过，如果本月晚些时候或11月初、游戏发售前有更多专辑消息，也并不令人意外。

paragraphs.en: All of this news is coming just hours after 25 minutes of new GTA 6 gameplay leaked on the internet . The new footage comes from Cyberleek, who was responsible for leaking a ton of GTA gameplay in August. Rockstar has yet to respond to the new footage, but is likely hoping that the news around the game's radio station serves as an ample distraction.
paragraphs.cn: 就在这些消息公布前几个小时，网上泄露了25分钟的《GTA6》新实机画面。这批画面来自Cyberleek，此人曾在8月泄露大量《GTA》实机画面。Rockstar尚未回应这批新画面，但很可能希望游戏电台的消息能充分转移大家的注意力。

paragraphs.en: IGN also posted a full transcript of its interview with Rob Nelson, the studio co-head of Rockstar North . Nelson demoed GTA 6 for IGN earlier this summer and revealed a variety of new information regarding the game in our conversation with him.
paragraphs.cn: IGN还发布了对Rockstar North工作室联席负责人Rob Nelson的完整采访实录。今年夏天早些时候，Nelson曾向IGN演示《GTA6》，并在与我们的交谈中透露了有关游戏的多项新信息。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.
